newFindings.detail: jsonSafe array branch counts Object.keys and validates .every, but ignores own Symbol keys. Both analyzeCasts and scenarioBounds accept array metadata that JSON.stringify silently drops.
Array own non-enumerable source metadata is accepted but omitted from contextSnapshot/contextIdentity; unlike plain objects, array property descriptors are not inspected.

Sparse array ['x', <hole>] with an extra enumerable string property has Object.keys.length === array.length; .every skips hole. Validator accepts, JSON.stringify replaces hole with null and drops extra metadata.
Array subclass inherited toJSON and own non-enumerable toJSON are accepted; JSON.stringify invokes custom serialization, changing validated profession context before snapshot/identity creation.

exactReproduction.environment: JavaScript V8 Function harness with node:assert/strict compatible shim, exact GitHub model and independent fixture semantics

previousRepairStatus.caveat: Native pipeline does not execute newly added array-attestation suite; its success does not clear this finding

risk: An accepted array profession/unlock context can lose hidden metadata or be replaced by toJSON while contextIdentity appears legitimate. This affects reproducibility and source-context attestation, not demonstrated live EV leakage.
repairRequirements: For every array, require Array.prototype or a documented safe prototype, reject own symbol keys, reject own non-index keys except native length, reject extra non-enumerable own keys, and reject own/inherited custom toJSON before snapshot.
Verify each index 0..length-1 is an own enumerable data property; reject sparse arrays even when extra keys compensate.
Validate snapshot/identity equivalence after serialization, with no custom serialization hooks; preserve explicit null distinctly from missing holes.
Rerun old strict 23/23 and new strict 13/13 under native Node; require new fixture SHA pin before adding CI gate.
testsNotRun: Native Node execution of new 13-case suite
